service.en: Abu Dhabi Real Estate Owner Visa

about: Two-year residence for people who fully own a finished property.
note: Requirements read from the official ADDED long-term residency page on the checked date. The visa itself is applied for through ICP, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The property must be fully built and habitable, not vacant land
The applicant must own it outright
Monthly income of at least AED 10,000, or proof of financial solvency during the stay
documents: Ownership certificate from the emirate's real estate registration authority
timing: The visa lasts 2 years and can be renewed if the conditions are still met
channels: ADDED contact line 800555, 8 am to 3 pm, or contact@tamm.abudhabi
